content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 3.4 (¶p0022) is the sole audit/inspection right running against us. It already meets two fallback elements — 30 days' prior written notice (better than the 15-day fallback) and HDI bearing all inspection fees outright (better than a 10% underpayment carve-out) — and is confined to business hours and payment-calculation records only, with no system-access language anywhere in the Agreement.

It failed the fallback on frequency: the right was uncapped, so HDI could inspect repeatedly. I proposed a single surgical edit inserting "no more than once per year" into the existing operative sentence, preserving the notice, business-hours and cost mechanics untouched. Preferred-only extras (independent auditor, confidentiality undertaking, off-site conduct, 5% cost-shift) were noted in the rationale rather than redlined, since the clause otherwise sits at or above the fallback.
